Planned Requirement: Audio response chunk handling (base64 WAV chunk concatenation) and sample rate validity
Actual Source Code: sarvamTts() executes `const audioBase64 = data.audios?.join('') ?? data.audio_base64 ?? ''` and returns `sampleRate: 22050`; frontend creates `data:audio/wav;base64,${audioBase64}`
Tests: TWO TECHNICAL BUGS: (1) When Sarvam TTS returns multiple chunks in `data.audios[]` for longer text, each element is a complete base64-encoded WAV file with its own 44-byte RIFF/WAVE header. Naively joining base64 strings (`data.audios.join('')`) produces invalid mid-stream base64 padding (`=`) and embedded RIFF headers, corrupting playback after the first chunk. (2) Bulbul v3 defaults to 24000 Hz sample rate unless `speech_sample_rate` is specified, whereas `sarvamTts` hardcodes `sampleRate: 22050`.
